atom_id.description: The EXACT system identifier. MUST exactly match one of the short aliases provided in <BLIND_ATOMS_TO_EVALUATE> (e.g. 'a0', 'a1').
atom_id.title: Atom Id

used_source_aliases.description: List of exact <search_result id> strings you relied upon for this specific extraction.
used_source_aliases.title: Used Source Aliases

rule_internalization.description: Brief internalization of the rule requirements and criteria in English.
rule_internalization.title: Rule Internalization

source_document_aliases.description: Dynamic literals corresponding to available documents.
source_document_aliases.title: Source Document Aliases

exact_quotes.description: Extract up to 3 physically contiguous sentences. Do not stitch them together. ABSOLUTE PRIORITY over contextual override. MUST be empty if contextual_override is True. You MUST always return a JSON object list format: `[{"text": "..."}]`. If the rule is a negative constraint and the text complies with it, return an empty list [].
exact_quotes.title: Exact Quotes

reasoning_steps.description: Step-by-step mechanical audit trace BEFORE making a decision. Format: '1) Rule requires X. 2) Text provides Y. 3) Y meets/fails X.' Max 3 sentences.
reasoning_steps.title: Reasoning Steps

falsification_argument.description: Why this evidence might NOT satisfy the strict causal requirement of the rule.
falsification_argument.title: Falsification Argument

decision.description: True if the condition is physically met, False otherwise.
decision.title: Decision

semantic_reasoning.description: Final summary of the decision. You MUST use Markdown formatting (e.g. bolding, bullet points, headers) INSIDE this JSON string to structure your analysis.
semantic_reasoning.title: Semantic Reasoning

LLMExtractedQuote.description: Schema for quotes extracted by the LLM, tracking their resolved document ID.
LLMExtractedQuote.title: LLMExtractedQuote

evaluations.description: List of atomic evaluations. You MUST evaluate ONLY the exact atoms explicitly listed in <BLIND_ATOMS_TO_EVALUATE>. You MUST include the exact 'atom_id' for each evaluation. Do NOT hallucinate, invent, or evaluate any unlisted concepts.
evaluations.title: Evaluations

evaluation_notes.description: General qualitative evaluation notes and analytical synthesis.
evaluation_notes.title: Evaluation Notes

reasoning_trace.description: Write an extensive analytical reasoning trace explaining your decision-making process. You MUST use Markdown formatting (e.g. bolding, bullet points, headers) INSIDE this JSON string to structure your analysis. You MUST write this trace in the EN locale.
reasoning_trace.title: Reasoning Trace
